carousels.title: Gen Z's Record Share of Mortgage Rate Locks
carousels.caption: Gen Z is making moves in the housing market! Learn how younger buyers are securing their homeownership dreams despite affordability challenges. #GenZHomebuyers #MortgageRates #FirstTimeHomeBuyer
carousels.hero_heading: Generation Z Sets Record for Home Purchase Rate Locks
carousels.hero_sub: Younger buyers are securing their piece of the American Dream in increasing numbers.
carousels.problem_sub: Many assume homeownership is out of reach for younger generations due to current market conditions.
carousels.solution_heading: Young Buyers Are Making It Happen
carousels.solution_sub: Despite challenges, Generation Z is actively entering the housing market, showing that strategic planning and support can lead to homeownership.
carousels.quote: The increasing share of Gen Z rate locks demonstrates a persistent drive for homeownership across all age groups.

features.label: Record Participation
features.desc: Gen Z accounted for a record 20% of home purchase rate locks in Q2.

features.label: Growing Influence
features.desc: This marks their largest share on record, indicating a rising presence in the market.

features.label: Overcoming Challenges
features.desc: Younger buyers are gaining ground despite ongoing affordability concerns.

features.label: Market Adaptation
features.desc: It shows a significant shift in how younger generations approach buying a home.

carousels.details_sub: The success of Gen Z buyers highlights that age and market conditions don't have to be barriers to homeownership.

carousels.title: Mortgage Rates: What to Expect This Week
carousels.caption: Good news for mortgage rates! With a light week for economic data, we're likely to see stability. Learn what this means for your home loan. #MortgageRates #HousingMarket #InterestRates
carousels.hero_heading: Mortgage Rates Likely to Stay Flat This Week
carousels.hero_sub: A quiet economic calendar points to stable mortgage rates, offering a window of predictability.
carousels.problem_sub: Many prospective homebuyers worry about sudden shifts in mortgage rates, making it hard to plan.
carousels.solution_sub: With minimal impactful economic data scheduled, mortgage rates are expected to remain relatively stable, differing from recent volatile periods.
carousels.quote: A light week for economic data means mortgage rates will likely print flat, providing a calmer environment for buyers.

features.label: Predictable Planning
features.desc: Less volatility allows for more confident financial planning and decision-making.

features.label: Reduced Pressure
features.desc: Homebuyers can take their time without the stress of rapidly changing rates.

features.label: Clearer Budgeting
features.desc: A stable rate environment helps in accurately estimating monthly mortgage payments.

features.label: Opportunity to Act
features.desc: This period can be ideal for securing a pre-approval or locking in a favorable rate.

carousels.details_sub: A period of flat rates provides an excellent opportunity to focus on your home search and secure your financing without immediate rate anxiety.

carousels.title: Homeownership: Giving Back to Your Community
carousels.caption: Buying or selling a home is more than a transaction—it's an investment in your community. Discover the local benefits of homeownership! #CommunityImpact #HomeownershipBenefits #LocalEconomy
carousels.hero_heading: Homeownership: An Investment in Your Community
carousels.hero_sub: Buying or selling a home contributes significantly to the health and vitality of your local area.
carousels.problem_heading: Is It Just a Personal Decision?
carousels.problem_sub: Many view home buying or selling as solely a personal financial move, overlooking its broader community effects.
carousels.solution_sub: Every home transaction has a ripple effect, supporting local businesses, services, and public funds that benefit everyone.
carousels.quote: Buying or selling a home is a big financial decision that also gives back to your community in significant ways.

features.label: Support for Local Businesses

features.label: Neighborhood Stability
